name: HOC Drive to Client Bot
triggers: Google Drive OAuth watches ONLY folder HOC Clients: fileCreated, fileUpdated, folderCreated
Webhook GET+POST /webhook/hoc-drive-file — GET health/poll kick; POST file id under HOC Clients → Laravel poll --file
action: POST https://api.hoc.agency/api/integrations/drive/poll with X-N8N-Secret (no $env — n8n Cloud blocks env access). Folders outside HOC Clients are ignored. No every-minute scan of the whole Drive.
laravel: ops:poll-drive --file={id} sends that file only when it is under GOOGLE_DRIVE_PARENT_FOLDER_ID (HOC Clients).
